skillset.skill: 15s CT - 4000% Dark DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by [30 x # of Current Wave].
skillset.arts: 22000% Dark DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 100 if used when ownself is not affected by Status ailments. For 60s, reduce enemies' Dark RES by 30% (stackable).
skillset.truearts: 120000% Dark DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 50 if used when ownself is not affected by Status ailments. Additionally, increase next Super Arts and next Origin Bullet's DMG by 300% each time True Arts is used (stackable, MAX: 1500%).
skillset.superarts: 200000% Dark DMG (PHY). For 45s, ignore enemies' DEF by 100%.
skillset.originbullet: Can be activated instead of Super Arts - 300000% Dark DMG (PHY). Doubles Origin Bullet's DMG Multiplier against enemies under 50% HP. Additionally, doubles Origin Bullet's DMG Multiplier again against enemies under 25% HP (Can only be used once per Quest).

passive.ability1: Permanently increase own DMG by 50% for each enemy defeated by ownself (MAX: 500%).
passive.ability3: Increase own DMG against Human enemies by 40%.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Simon the Eradicator's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Simon the Eradicator's SP. Art is owned)

true1.name: Black Mass
true1.skill: 55s CT - 10000% Dark DMG (PHY). For 8s, reduce enemies' Dark RES by 30%. Additionally if user is Human, for 8s, reduce enemies' DMG RES by 20%.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Simon the Eradicator, increase Origin Bullet's usage count by 1. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.

true2.name: Dark Prayer
true2.skill: 40s CT - 9000% Dark DMG (MAG). Increase own Arts by 30. Additionally if user is Dark, for 10s, increase own stats by 30%.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Simon the Eradicator, increase own DMG by 20% and Arts by 2/s. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
